fieldTransforms.dateEntered: M/D/YYYY to ISO YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates null
fieldTransforms.categoryUnknowns: Blank, Unknown, TBD, N/A and NaN become null; literal None is retained as an actual source category

excludedSourceFields: Cohort Z Min / Z Max normalization bounds
notes: Portfolio demo snapshot of the publicly published source CSV; not a live feed.
John Kew's content usage policy requires express written permission to republish or modify paddle data.
Hand speed is the source's Hand Speed Index (0–100), copied without recalculating. It is not directly timed reaction speed.
Power and pop use the source's current fields, not its retired radar columns. Missing values remain null and sort last.
Retail prices are snapshot values in USD. No affiliate links, images, reviews, or source prose are included.
Each source row is retained, including used-condition and repeated model variants. IDs are unique within this snapshot.
Spin durability tier is copied from the actual Spin Durability Tier CSV column. Grit/surface texture is a separate actual source field; no tier is inferred from material, brand, or model.

37 numeric fields are declared: 32 from the base CSV plus four supplemental KewCOR centerline points and their derived range. Supplemental coverage and timestamps are recorded separately. Current and retired speeds are never mixed.
Category values are source text; blank/unknown markers become null, and source entry dates are normalized to ISO. Source cohort normalization bounds and affiliate fields are excluded.

kewcorCurve.sourceName: John Kew Paddle Comparison Lab — Curves feed

derivedFields.kewcorDelta: Decimal max(K3,K4,K5,K6) minus min(K3,K4,K5,K6); all four finite source values required

kewcorCurve.joinPolicy: Exact case-sensitive brand/model strings and numerically equal thickness. If the feed omits condition, the base variant must be unique. No aliases, fuzzy matches, inferred points or single-KewCOR fallback.
kewcorCurve.retestPolicy: Dated tests supersede undated history; newest dated test wins. Conflicting equally recent tests remain unknown; identical latest duplicates use lowest source row.

metrics.label: Hand speed
metrics.description: John Kew's source-provided Hand Speed Index (0–100). Higher means easier to swing. This is a handling index, not a direct measurement of reaction time.

metrics.label: Swing weight
metrics.description: Source-measured rotational inertia. Lower values generally feel easier to swing; this alone is not a timed hand-speed measurement.

metrics.label: Twist weight
metrics.description: Source-measured resistance to twisting on off-center contact. Higher values indicate more rotational stability.

metrics.label: Spin
metrics.description: Spin RPM from the source spreadsheet. Missing results stay blank.

metrics.label: Power
metrics.description: The source's current Serve Speed-MPH (Power) field, based on KewCOR. Retired radar readings are not substituted when this is missing.

metrics.label: Pop
metrics.description: The source's current Punch Volley Speed-MPH (Pop) field, based on KewCOR. Retired radar readings are not substituted when this is missing.

metrics.label: Firepower
metrics.description: The source-provided Firepower (0–100) value, preserved without recalculating.

metrics.label: Retail price
metrics.description: Listed retail price in the source snapshot, in USD. Discount and affiliate prices are excluded; prices may change.

metrics.label: KewCOR

metrics.description: Historical Punch Volley Speed-MPH (Radar, retired) column. Different source measurement series from current pop; never substituted for current pop.

metrics.label: KewCOR at 3 in
metrics.description: Actual source K3 measurement, 3 inches below the paddle tip along the face centerline. Dimensionless; source precision is retained. Missing or ambiguous variant matches remain blank.

metrics.label: KewCOR at 4 in
metrics.description: Actual source K4 measurement, 4 inches below the paddle tip along the face centerline. Dimensionless; source precision is retained. Missing or ambiguous variant matches remain blank.

metrics.label: KewCOR at 5 in
metrics.description: Actual source K5 measurement, 5 inches below the paddle tip along the face centerline. Dimensionless; source precision is retained. Missing or ambiguous variant matches remain blank.

metrics.label: KewCOR at 6 in
metrics.description: Actual source K6 measurement, 6 inches below the paddle tip along the face centerline. Dimensionless; source precision is retained. Missing or ambiguous variant matches remain blank.

metrics.label: KewCOR delta (3–6 in)
metrics.description: Derived range: max(K3, K4, K5, K6) minus min(K3, K4, K5, K6), using all four actual measurements at 3, 4, 5 and 6 inches below the tip. Lower means more uniform response across these four points, not higher power. All four points are required; no curve is inferred from the separate single KewCOR field.

categories.label: Brand

categories.label: Spin durability tier
categories.description: Actual Spin Durability Tier from the source CSV, copied without inferring from grit material. Tier 1 is the source's highest retention tier. A missing rating is unknown, not Tier 1.

categories.label: Grit / surface texture
categories.description: Actual Surface Texture from the source CSV. Texture material and spin durability tier are separate fields; no durability is inferred from texture.

categories.label: Spin category
categories.description: Source-provided qualitative spin category, preserved without recalculating.
